name: Fitness Load Dribbling and Running
desc: Stage II: fitness load activity. Players are dribbling in their square, coach blows the whistle and they have to run at 85% to the next box without the balls. Progression, players are juggling above their head with one touch.
howTo:
Players dribble inside their square.

name: 3rd Man Combination to Goal
desc: Stage III: Player A starts with a ball and passes it to player B. Player B lays the ball off to player A, who then plays a forward pass to player C. Player C lays the ball off to player B who showed underneath and came to support after player A made a pass to player C. As player C lays the ball off, he opens in a looping motion, then receives a ball back from player B, dribbles around the mannequin, and takes a shot on goal. He then collects the ball and returns back to the other line.
howTo:
A passes to B.
B lays the ball off to A.
A plays a forward pass to C.
C lays the ball off to B, who showed underneath to support.
As C lays it off, he opens in a looping motion.
C receives the ball back from B.
C dribbles around the mannequin and shoots on goal.
C collects the ball and returns to the other line.
info: Coaching points: Counter movement of a players to lose opponents. Weight, accuracy, and angle of passing. Movement to open the body and look to receive a ball on half turn. Movement to support the play after playing the ball and after laying it off. Third man recognition and involvement.

name: 7v7 Game

howTo:
Play 7v7 on a half-field space.

name: Three-Player Passing Pattern
desc: Three player passing pattern. Part of the dynamic warm up and stretch. A passes to B who is checking his shoulder and opening up his body posture as he receives the ball. Traps with the far foot, and plays the ball into C with the near foot. C takes the ball on the run, dribbles half the way and plays the ball to the back of the line to start over. Progression: A passes to B, B lays the ball to A, A plays it to C, C does a give and go with B. This is all 1 touch to go back to the start, and start over with one touch.
howTo:
A passes to B.
B checks his shoulder and opens his body posture to receive.
B traps with the far foot and plays to C with the near foot.
C takes the ball on the run, dribbles halfway, and plays it to the back of the line to start over.
Progression: A to B, B lays off to A, A plays to C, C does a give and go with B - all one touch, back to the start.

Attack three counter goals; scoring in one beyond the blue line in the final zone earns the right to attack the big goal.

name: Triangle Passing Pattern
desc: Dynamic warm up then progress to a triangle passing pattern. Part of the dynamic warm up and stretch. Three player passing pattern. A passes to B who plays a quick combination around the cone with A who followed his pass. C holds, and then makes a run, B plays a firm ball into his run, C dribbles back and starts the new sequence. Everyone follows their pass. Accuracy of the passes, weight, angle, timing of the movement and passing.
howTo:
Warm up dynamically, then progress to a triangle passing pattern.
A passes to B.
B plays a quick combination around the cone with A, who followed his pass.
C holds, then makes a run.
B plays a firm ball into C's run.
C dribbles back and starts the new sequence.
Everyone follows their pass.
info: Coaching points: Accuracy of the passes, weight, angle, timing of the movement and passing.

desc: Stage I: 4v2. Outside players have a 2 touch limit, except two on the sides have 1 touch limit. When they lose possession, they counter press to prevent the two in the middle dribbling the ball out of the rectangle. Introduce immediate reaction and concepts.

desc: Stage II: 4v4 +3. 18 yards by 14 yards space, no touch restrictions. Team in possession gets a point every 6 passes. Emphasis on quick transitional reaction once the possession is lost.

Play 4v4 + 3 in an 18 x 14 yard space with no touch restrictions
Team in possession scores a point every 6 passes
On losing possession, react quickly to win it back
info: Coaching point: quickly close down where the ball is lost. Closest players to the ball must react in a manner of winning it back. Farthest players must squeeze in to create numerical superiority in identified area of the field.

name: 6v6 + GK Transitional Fluid Game
desc: Stage III: 6v6+GK. Continuous transitional game, with players restricted to their own half of play. Attacking team has three front players and three midfielders, while the defending team has back four and two holding mids. Attacking team looks to score. Defensive team looks to defend, win possession and keep the ball. They keep possession with the team on the opposite end. 12 passes gives them a point, while a regular goal gives the other team a point.
howTo:
Continuous transitional game, players restricted to their own half
Attacking team: three front players and three midfielders; defending team: back four and two holding mids
Attacking team looks to score; defending team defends, wins possession and keeps the ball
12 passes earns a point; a regular goal earns the other team a point
info: Coaching points: REACTION. Once the possession is lost in the final third, can we quickly close the ball down with everyone squeezing, weak sided midfielders tucking in, to create numbers up situation. Continues movement to react and win the ball back without negative emotional reactions once the turn over has occurred.

name: 11v11 Murder Ball

info: REACTION. Once the possession is lost in the final third, can we quickly close the ball down with everyone squeezing, weak sided midfielders tucking in, to create numbers up situation.

name: Activation — Tag, Penny and Reaction Games
desc: Stage I: Activation. 3 players in a circle with hands held together. One player tries to go around trying to tag a player that is being protected. Tag game: grab a penny being held as a tail. The one with most pennies wins. Reaction game of running to one side or the other.
howTo:
3 players stand in a circle with hands held together; one player tries to go around trying to tag a player that is being protected.
Tag game: grab a penny being held as a tail; the one with the most pennies wins.
Reaction game: run to one side or the other.

name: 4v2 Four-Color Rondo
desc: 4 color game. Players play 4v2, must complete 4 passes before switching it over to the next grid and shifting over two players providing new passing lanes. 4 bouts of 3 mins.
howTo:
Play 4v2 in the four-color game.
Complete 4 passes before switching it over to the next grid.
Shift over two players, providing new passing lanes.
4 bouts of 3 minutes each.

name: 4v4 to Goal — Exploit Numerical Superiority
desc: Stage II: Exploit numerical superiority game. 3v1 in the square, after 5 passes, 2 blues advance to make it 4v3 to goal, while one red is recovering to defend. When blues score it counts as two goals, when reds score on counter goals it's 1 goal each.
howTo:
Play 3v1 in the square.
After 5 passes, 2 blues advance to make it 4v3 to goal, while one red is recovering to defend.
When blues score it counts as two goals; when reds score on counter goals it is 1 goal each.

name: Free Kicks
desc: Stage IV: Practice free kicks.
howTo: Practice free kicks.

name: Week 7: Session #24 - transition D--A from the midfield third
desc:
Week 7: Session#24 - transition from D-->A from the middle of the field
exploit numerical superiority by attacking quickly

Drills: Activation — Tag, Penny and Reaction Games (25 min); 4v2 Four-Color Rondo (25 min); 4v4 to Goal — Exploit Numerical Superiority (30 min); Free Kicks (20 min).
Stage I: 3v1 rondo activation
howTo:
Set up a 3v1 rondo.
Three attackers keep possession against one defender.
Use as the activation to start the session.
name: 3v1 Rondo Activation

desc: 5v5 + 3 possession. 3 bouts of 4 mins
howTo:
Play 5v5 with 3 neutral players supporting the team in possession.
Play 3 bouts of 4 minutes.
name: 5v5+3 Possession

desc: Stage III: 7v6 in each half. Team in build up looks to connect passes and advance the ball into the other half to the other team building out. Attackers look to press and score. 2 bouts of 10 mins
howTo:
Split the field into two halves with a 7v6 in each half, playing together in their own area.
The team in build-up connects passes and advances the ball into the other half to the team building out.
Attackers press and look to score.
Play 2 bouts of 10 minutes.
name: 7v6 Build-Up in Each Half

desc:
Week 7: Session#25 - Possession based offensive organization and implementation of principles

Drills: 3v1 Rondo Activation (20 mins), 5v5+3 Possession (20 mins), 7v6 Build-Up in Each Half (30 mins), 11v11 Game (25 mins)
name: Week 7: Session #25 - possession based offensive organization

desc: 6v6. 4 team round robin for points.
howTo:
Play 6v6 to 4 goals.
Run a 4-team round robin for points.
name: 6v6 to 4 Goals

desc: 9v9 with 3 teams round robin.
howTo: Play 9v9 with 3 teams in a round robin.
name: 9v9 Round Robin

desc:
3v3+2 and 4v4 mini tournament

Drills: 3v3+2 Possession (25 mins), 6v6 to 4 Goals (30 mins), 9v9 Round Robin (25 mins)
name: Week 7: Session #26 positional play games

desc: Dynamic warm up. 3v3+2
howTo:
Start with a dynamic warm-up.
Play 3v3+2.
name: 3v3+2 Dynamic Warm-Up

desc:
Week 7: Session #27
Warm up in 3v3+2 and then play
Attacking principles

Drills: 3v3+2 Dynamic Warm-Up (25 mins), 11v11 Game (4-3-3) (70 mins)
name: Week 7: Session #27 3v3+2 and 11v11

desc: Passing pattern to warm up. Play the ball and show underneath, play a far player and third man follows the pass to show underneath to advance the next pass and so on
howTo:
Play the ball and show underneath.
Play a far player.
The third man follows the pass to show underneath to advance the next pass.
Repeat the pattern.
name: Passing Pattern Warm-Up

desc: 7v7 in tight space
howTo: Play 7v7 in a tight space.
name: 7v7 in a Tight Space

desc:
Recovery session and game replication for players that played more

Drills: Passing Pattern Warm-Up (15 mins), 4v4+4 Possession (20 mins), 7v7 in a Tight Space (45 mins)
name: Week 8: Session 28 recovery session

desc: 4v1 rondo
howTo: Play a 4v1 rondo.
name: 4v1 Rondo

desc: 6v3 always in a hexagon. The three in the middle must score a goal to then be in possession
howTo:
Set up a hexagon with 6 players in possession and 3 in the middle.
The three in the middle must score a goal to then be in possession.
name: 6v3 in a Hexagon

desc: 11v11 two touch limit to small goals on either end. Three small goals on both ends.
howTo:
Play 11v11 in a tight space with a two-touch limit.
Play to small goals on either end — three small goals on both ends.
name: 11v11 in a Tight Space

desc: Drills: 4v1 Rondo (20 mins), 6v3 in a Hexagon (30 mins), 11v11 in a Tight Space (20 mins)
name: Week 8: Session #29 MD-1 session positional play activities

desc: Stage I: Passing pattern as part of the warm up. Ball starts with pass out wide. Give and go out wide to play forward. Play square and then wide. Another give and go. Give to the start through a pivot and start over. Everyone follows their pass
howTo:
Ball starts with a pass out wide.
Give and go out wide to play forward.
Play square and then wide.
Another give and go.
Give to the start through a pivot and start over.
Everyone follows their pass.
name: Build-Out Passing Pattern Warm-Up

desc: Stage II: Big space 4v4+3. 2 touch on the outside, 1 touch neutrals. Quick ball circulation, movement off the ball, passing lanes, breaking lines. Effective possession
howTo:
Play 4v4+3 in a big space.
Outside players are limited to 2 touches; neutrals play 1 touch.
Focus on quick ball circulation, movement off the ball, passing lanes, and breaking lines.
name: 4v4+3 Possession

desc: Stage III and IV: Building out of the back in 10v9 with advancing the ball to score on a goal in the middle. Full back pins inside, create 4v3 in the middle
howTo:
Build out of the back in 10v9, advancing the ball to score on a goal in the middle.
Full back pins inside to create a 4v3 in the middle.
Progress to 11v11.
name: 10v9 Building Out of the Back to 11v11

desc:
Week 8: Session #30
Building out of the back

Drills: Build-Out Passing Pattern Warm-Up (25 mins), 4v4+3 Possession (20 mins), 10v9 Building Out of the Back to 11v11 (35 mins)
name: Week 8: Session #30 Building out of the back

desc: Warm up: Dynamic activation. Different variations of tag games, changes of directions, stretches, and some sprints
howTo:
Dynamic activation.
Different variations of tag games.
Changes of direction, stretches, and some sprints.
name: Dynamic Warm-Up

desc: Stage I: Passing pattern. 2 balls start at the same time. 6 groups of 6
howTo:
Set up a diamond passing pattern in 6 groups of 6.
2 balls start at the same time.
name: Diamond Passing Pattern

desc: Stage II: Positional Play game. 3 teams of 5 players. 10 players in possession occupy their exact positions in a 4-3-3 set up. 5 players work in the middle, high pressing in identified areas. Once the group of 5 win the ball, then occupy positions of the 5 that they have stolen it from and keep it with the other color. The 5 that lost possession has to touch hands in the middle before starting to defend.
howTo:
Three teams of 5 players; 10 in possession occupy their exact positions in a 4-3-3 set-up.
The 5 players in the middle work high pressing in identified areas.
Once the group of 5 wins the ball, they occupy the positions of the 5 they stole it from and keep it with the other color.
The 5 that lost possession must touch hands in the middle before starting to defend.
name: Positional Play 10v5 in Three Colors

desc: Stage III and IV: 11v11 game. High press against the team in build up
howTo:
Play an 11v11 game.
Press high against the team in build-up.
name: 11v11 Game — High Press

desc:
Transitional REACTION to get the ball back once it's lost with the main emphasis in the final third of the field. Constant emphasis on reaction, no negative emotions shown when the ball is lost but entire intent to win it back.

Drills: Dynamic Warm-Up (15 mins), Diamond Passing Pattern (15 mins), Positional Play 10v5 in Three Colors (20 mins), 11v11 Game — High Press (30 mins)
name: Week 9: Session 31 - MD-1 - high press in the attacking third
3v1
desc: Stage I and warm up. 3v1 rondo with a 1 touch limit.
howTo:
Play 3v1.
1 touch limit.
info:
Body positioning and orientation.
Movement off the ball to give passing lanes.
Deception in passing.
Intention and specificity of passing.
Finding the back foot, leading into the next action.

name: 5v5 + 2 Offensive Bumpers
desc: Stage III and IV: 5v5 in tight space + 2 bumpers on the attacking end. 3 min games and rotate teams.
howTo:
Play 5v5 in a tight space with 2 bumpers on the attacking end.
Play 3 min games and rotate teams.

name: Week 9: Session 32 - MD+1 session for guys that did not play
desc: Drills: 3v1 (15 mins); 3v3+2 (20 mins); 5v5 + 2 Offensive Bumpers (30 mins).

name: Functional Activation
desc: Stage I. Dynamic and functional activation.
howTo: Run a dynamic and functional activation.

name: 11v11+3 Possession
desc: Stage II: 11v11 + 3 Neutrals possession game in the top of the box to half way line space.
howTo: Play 11v11 + 3 neutrals possession in the space from the top of the box to the half way line.

name: 11v11 Positional Understanding
desc: Stage III and IV: 11v11 top of the box one goal, the other one regular set up. Exploiting half spaces, working on positional rotations to create numerical superiorities. Build up play in the middle third to unbalance opponent and find teammates in dangerous areas.
howTo:
Set up 11v11, one goal at the top of the box and the other a regular set up.
Exploit half spaces with positional rotations to create numerical superiorities.
Build up play in the middle third to unbalance the opponent and find teammates in dangerous areas.

name: Week 9: Session 33 - MD-1 session
desc:
Positional understanding and attacking principles. Create and exploit numerical advantage in the attacking third and wide areas by exploiting half spaces
Drills: Functional Activation (30 mins); 11v11+3 Possession (25 mins); 11v11 Positional Understanding (30 mins).

name: Rondo 5v2
desc: Warm up and Stage I: 5v2 rondo in a 8x8 square. Go from up to two touch, one touch only. Include stretches in between bouts.
howTo:
Play 5v2 rondo in an 8x8 square.
Start with up to two touches, then one touch only.
Include stretches in between bouts.
info: Passing lanes, back foot passing, weight of the pass, quality, accuracy.

name: 5v5+4 Positional Play
desc: Stage II: Positional play, 5v5 + 4. Two GKs on each end as two neutrals, and two CMs in the middle as two neutrals as well. In transition, team that wins the ball occupies outside positions.
howTo:
Play 5v5 + 4 positional play.
Two GKs on each end act as two neutrals, and two CMs in the middle act as two neutrals.
In transition, the team that wins the ball occupies outside positions.

name: Set Pieces
desc: Stage III: Defensive and offensive set pieces.
howTo: Work on defensive and offensive set pieces.

name: Shooting
desc: Shooting. 4 goals.
howTo:
Player on the right dribbles by the mannequin and takes a shot.
Player in the middle does a give and go around a mannequin and shoots.
Player on the right does a give and go around the mannequin, gets sent through for a cross, and sends a firm ball on the ground for the first two shooters to finish, who make a near post and back post runs.
Switch lines.

name: Week 9: Session 34 - MD-1 Session
desc:
MD-1 session. Possession, combinations, playing quickly through the middle, reinforcing partnerships on the field. Set pieces
Drills: Rondo 5v2 (15 mins); 5v5+4 Positional Play (20 mins); Set Pieces (30 mins); Shooting (20 mins).

name: 3v3+2 Warm-Up
desc: Stage I: Part of the dynamic warm up and stretch. 3v3+2.
howTo: Play 3v3+2 as part of the dynamic warm up and stretch.

name: 8v6 Build-Up to Three Counter Goals
desc: Stage II and III: 8v6 to three counter goals. Working on build up. Team working on build up must be in the final zone over the line to score on one of the three counter goals. Team pressing has 10 seconds to score if they steal a ball.
howTo:
Play 8v6 to three counter goals, working on build up.
The build-up team must be in the final zone over the line to score on one of the three counter goals.
The pressing team has 10 seconds to score if they steal the ball.
info: Find the open player and explore numerical superiority.

name: Building out of the back. In possession in the defensive third of the field
desc:
Preseason session #2: Passing patterns, 3rd man runs, building a fitness bass and returning back to play
Drills: 3v3+2 Warm-Up (30 mins); 8v6 Build-Up to Three Counter Goals (40 mins); 11v11 Game (30 mins).

name: Warm-Up 3v1
desc: Warm up. Part of the dynamic warm up and stretch. 3v1 one touch.
howTo: Play 3v1 one touch as part of the dynamic warm up and stretch.

name: Passing Pattern with a Finish on Goal
desc: Stage II: Passing pattern to break a line and get in behind the defense.
howTo:
A #8 plays the ball into the #9.
The #9 lays it off to the #8.
The #8 chips it over the back line for an oncoming player from the other side to finish.

name: 7v7 to Two Goals
desc: Stage II and III: 7v7 to two goals. Attacking team of front three and three midfielders must unbalance the back line and two pivots, and beat the offsides trap to get in behind.
howTo:
Play 7v7 to two goals.
The attacking team (front three and three midfielders) must unbalance the back line and two pivots and beat the offsides trap to get in behind.
The defending team has 10 seconds to get a shot on goal.
info: Timing of the runs. Synchronization. Quality of a pass. Find the open player and explore numerical superiority.

name: Creating chances and finishing in the final third. Unbalancing the opponent and runs in behind
desc:
Week 3: Session #10. Runs in behind and unbalancing the opponent in the final third
Drills: Warm-Up 3v1 (20 mins); Passing Pattern with a Finish on Goal (20 mins); 7v7 to Two Goals (30 mins); 11v11 Game (20 mins).

name: Passing Pattern Using the Mids
desc: Stage I: Part of the dynamic warm up, passing pattern.
howTo:
Find a pivot and lay the ball off to the other runner.
Play the attacking mid.
Then play to the other side.

name: 7v6 Build-Up in the Middle
desc: Stage II and III: 7v6. Emphasis is on unbalancing the opponent and advancing the ball forward in the middle third. Emphasis team works with back 4 and three midfielders. The counter team has front three and three midfielders. Emphasis team can not use the GK in build up. Working on finding a way how to progress the ball forward through the pivot and creating numerical superiority in the back.
howTo:
Play 7v6: emphasis team with a back 4 and three midfielders, counter team with a front three and three midfielders.
The emphasis team can not use the GK in build up.
Progress the ball forward through the pivot, creating numerical superiority in the back.
The pressing team has 10 seconds to score if they steal the ball.
info: Identify an open player and exploit it.

name: Unbalancing the opponent and building up in the middle third
desc:
Preseason session #2: Passing patterns, 3rd man runs, building a fitness bass and returning back to play
Drills: 4v1 Rondo (15 mins); Passing Pattern Using the Mids (10 mins); 7v6 Build-Up in the Middle (40 mins); 11v11 Game (25 mins).
